Recorded provisions

Provision headings, locators and summaries are recorded research metadata, not quotations from the instrument.

  • P-01 — Citation and commencement

    The Law is cited as the Personal Data Protection Law of 2023 and commences six months after publication in the Official Gazette.

    Open source — Recorded locator: Article (1). Locator recorded; no deep link is fabricated. Open the source and locate it there.

    Evidence status: Recorded provision metadata; Effect assessment: Not assessed; Encoding status: Blocked; Relation review: Unreviewed. Open interpretation questions: JO-24-01

  • P-02 — Temporal application

    The Law applies to data even if collected or processed before commencement, subject to the stated exclusion for personal use.

    Open source — Recorded locator: Article (3). Locator recorded; no deep link is fabricated. Open the source and locate it there.

    Evidence status: Recorded provision metadata; Effect assessment: Not assessed; Encoding status: Blocked; Relation review: Unreviewed. Open interpretation questions: JO-24-02

  • P-03 — Prior consent and data-subject rights

    Processing generally requires prior consent or another situation permitted by law, and the data subject is given enumerated rights.

    Open source — Recorded locator: Article (4). Locator recorded; no deep link is fabricated. Open the source and locate it there.

Open interpretation questions

Candidate interpretation, not legally reviewed.

  • JO-24-01

    The publication date and resulting six-month commencement date are not established from the captured English translation.

    Recorded observation: Article (1) states that the Law enters into force six months after publication in the Official Gazette.

    Provision P-01

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Source capture.

  • JO-24-02

    The retroactive application to data processed before commencement needs a clause-level scope analysis.

    Recorded observation: Article (3)(A) applies the Law to data collected or processed before it comes into force.

    Provision P-02

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified legal review.

  • JO-24-03

    The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; the authoritative-language status is unresolved.

    Recorded observation: The captured PDF contains English and Arabic text described as an official English translation.

    Provision P-03

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Translation review.
